question: How do I create a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To create a kMeet meeting: 1) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or from the desktop/mobile app. 2) Start a new meeting. 3) Enter a name for your meeting room. 4) Allow access to webcam and microphone. 5) Enter your name or pseudonym. 6) Optionally enable participant control, password, or encryption. 7) Click 'Join the meeting'. 8) Share the room link to invite participants.
answer:
To create a kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.
2. Click the button to **Create a Meeting**.
3. Enter a **name** for your meeting room.
4. Click on the **security options** (if you want to protect your meeting with a password or encryption key).
5. **Continue** to **start** the meeting.
6. Specify the name you want to use as a participant in the meeting.
7. Share the **meeting link or code** and, if necessary, the **password** (which you can re-display at this step) with your participants.

Source: [Create a kMeet meeting](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2475/create-a-kmeet-meeting)

question: How can I share my screen during a kMeet call?
ground_truth: To share your screen in kMeet: 1) Have the desktop app (macOS/Windows) or mobile app (Android) - screen sharing is not yet available on iOS. 2) Create or join a meeting. 3) Click on the screen icon with an arrow to 'Share your screen'. 4) Validate authorization to access screen content. 5) Choose to share the entire screen or a specific window. 6) Click button to start sharing. 7) To stop, click the toolbar icon again. Note: Permissions may require a restart on first use.
key_points: choose entire screen or specific window
answer:
To share your screen during a kMeet call, follow these steps:

1. **Start kMeet**: Open kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.
2. **Join a Meeting Room**: [Create](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2475) or [join](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2473) a meeting room.
3. **Initiate Screen Sharing**:
   - Click on the screen icon with an arrow to **Share your screen**.
   - Read the warning that may be displayed by your device and validate the authorization to access the screen content.
   - By default, it is the **entire** screen that will be shared in the next step, but you can also choose a **specific window**, that of an application for example, in order to restrict the participants' view to a specific activity of the device. Be careful, if the purpose of the sharing is to then allow participants to interact by drawing, you must choose to share the full screen.
   - Click the button to start the **sharing**.
4. **Stop Sharing**: To stop the broadcast, click again on the toolbar icon.

Source: [Share your screen on kMeet](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2477/share-your-screen-on-kmeet)

question: What should I do if my audio is not working in kMeet?
ground_truth: To fix audio issues in kMeet: 1) Go to kMeet Settings and reauthorize microphone access. 2) Check browser lock icon isn't blocking multimedia. 3) On mobile, check Settings > Privacy > Microphone permissions for kMeet. 4) On Windows, use Privacy settings and Audio Troubleshooter. 5) Try joining from a different device (mobile instead of computer or vice versa). 6) As last resort on Firefox, disable WebRTC in about:config by setting media.peerconnection.enabled to false.
answer:
To resolve audio issues in kMeet, follow these steps:

1. **Check Permissions**:
   - Access kMeet settings by clicking on the icon at the top right of the interface.
   - Ensure that access to the microphone is authorized. Choose the appropriate device from the list.

2. **Browser or Application Settings**:
   - For the kMeet application on your computer, verify that the necessary permissions are granted.
   - For the web version, check that a lock icon in the browser's address bar is not blocking multimedia access by clicking on the lock icon.

3. **Operating System Permissions**:
   - On macOS, go to **System Settings** under **Privacy and Security** then **Screen Recording**.
   - Add your browser or kMeet application if necessary and ensure the required permissions are activated.

4. **Restart the Application**:
   - If it's your first time using or sharing your screen, the requested permissions by the operating system or browser may require a restart of the application, which might interrupt the meeting.

5. **Check Firewall Settings**:
   - Ensure that your firewall settings allow kMeet streams. Allow UDP protocol on port `443` and TCP port `443` for the turn server. Allow the IP addresses `185.125.24.0/24` (TCP) and `185.125.24.0/24` (UDP).

6. **Switch Connections**:
   - If issues persist, try switching connections (e.g., from WiFi to 4G/5G) to check if a firewall is causing desynchronizations.

For more detailed instructions, refer to the [Infomaniak support page on fixing audio issues](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2441/fix-an-audio-issue-on-kmeet).

question: How do I create side rooms (breakout rooms) in kMeet?
ground_truth: To create side rooms in kMeet: 1) You must be a moderator. 2) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or app. 3) Once participants are in the meeting, click on the multi-user icon in the toolbar. 4) Click the button to add a side room. 5) Participants can then join or leave the room. 6) The moderator can force participants to join a specific side room via the action menu. Side rooms allow dividing a main meeting into several simultaneous discussions in distinct virtual spaces.
key_points: moderator can force participants to join
answer:
To create side rooms (breakout rooms) in kMeet, follow these steps:

1. Start kMeet as a moderator via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computer or mobile devices.
2. Once the participants are in the meeting, click on the multi-user icon in the kMeet toolbar.
3. Click the button to add a side room.
4. Participants can then join the created room or leave it by displaying the menu with the same button as in step 2.
5. The moderator can also force one of the participants to join one of the side rooms by clicking on the action menu on the right in the list.

Source: [Create a kMeet meeting side room](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2397/create-a-kmeet-meeting-side-room)

question: How can I record a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To record a kMeet meeting: Prerequisites: Have a kDrive, be the moderator, and don't use encrypted meeting with custom key. Steps: 1) Start kMeet. 2) Once in the meeting, click on the action menu (three dots). 3) Click 'Start recording'. 4) Log in to Infomaniak if needed and select a kDrive for storage. 5) To stop, click the toolbar again and choose 'Stop recording'. 6) The recording is saved to the kDrive root in .mp4 format when all participants leave. Maximum duration is 3 hours.
answer:
To record a kMeet meeting on kDrive, follow these steps:

1. **Start kMeet**: Begin by launching kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or through one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.

2. **Initiate Recording**:
   - Once in the meeting, click on the action menu (○○○) in the kMeet toolbar.
   - Click on the icon ◉ **Start recording**.

3. **Confirm and Log In**:
   - Confirm the operation and, if necessary, log in to your Infomaniak account.
   - Select a kDrive to save the video conference and then click the button to start the recording.

4. **Stop Recording**:
   - To stop the recording, click on the toolbar again.
   - Choose **Stop recording** and confirm the action.

5. **Access the Recording**:
   - The recording will be available at the root of the chosen kDrive as soon as the virtual room in which the meeting was held is closed (i.e., as soon as all participants have left the video conference).

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the [official guide on saving a kMeet meeting on kDrive](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2472/save-a-kmeet-meeting-on-kdrive).

question: How do I set a password for my kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To protect a kMeet meeting with a password: 1) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or app. 2) Start a new meeting. 3) Enter the meeting room name. 4) Click on 'security options'. 5) Enable the toggle switch to 'Protect access'. 6) Create the password. 7) Click Continue to start. 8) Share both the meeting link/code AND the password with participants. You can also enable end-to-end encryption from security options (works only with Chromium-based browsers).
answer:
To set a password for your kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the apps for computers or mobile devices.
2. Click the button to start a new meeting.
3. Enter a name for your meeting room.
4. Click on the chevron below the meeting name to expand the advanced options.
5. Activate the "Protect access" toggle switch.
6. Create and confirm the password.
7. Click "Continue" to start the meeting.
8. Share the meeting link or code along with the password with your participants.

For more details, refer to the [Infomaniak documentation on securing a kMeet meeting with a password and encryption key](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2464/secure-a-kmeet-meeting-with-a-password-and-encryption-key).

question: How can I livestream a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To livestream a kMeet meeting: Prerequisites: Must be a moderator (no Video Streaming offer required). Steps: 1) Start kMeet via ksuite.infomaniak.com/kmeet or app. 2) Once in the meeting, click the action menu (three dots). 3) Choose 'Start live broadcast'. 4) Click 'Start' button. 5) Wait for Video Streaming to be created. 6) Copy the stream URL and share it with viewers. 7) A symbol and audio alert indicate the broadcast start. The stream is continuous for max 24 hours and stops when the kMeet meeting ends.
answer: The documentation does not provide information on how to livestream a kMeet meeting. For further assistance, please contact Infomaniak support.

question: How do I install kDrive on Linux?
ground_truth: To install kDrive on Linux: Prerequisites: Download the kDrive .AppImage file, install libfuse2 (required for Ubuntu 23.04+: sudo apt install libfuse2), D-Bus, and gnome-keyring or kwallet. Steps: 1) Place the .AppImage file in an 'Applications' folder. 2) Right-click the file and select 'Permissions'. 3) Check 'Allow executing file as a program'. Note: Officially supported on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS+ with GNOME or KDE. Lite Sync and right-click context menu not available on Linux. For Ubuntu startup, add to 'Startup Application Preferences'. For GNOME icon, install AppIndicator extension.
key_points: Lite Sync not available on Linux
answer:
To install kDrive on Linux, follow these steps:

1. **Download the kDrive AppImage file** for Linux from the official Infomaniak website.
2. **Place the file in a folder** named "Applications" or any preferred location.
3. **Set the file to be executable**:
   - Right-click on the file and select "Properties".
   - Check the box "Allow executing file as a program".

4. **Install Fuse2** (required to run AppImage):
   - Open a terminal and run the command: `sudo apt install libfuse2`

5. **Run the kDrive application**:
   - Double-click the AppImage file to launch the application.

6. **Optional: Set kDrive to run at startup** (for Ubuntu):
   - Go to "Startup Application Preferences" and add the kDrive file.

7. **Optional: Install AppIndicator** (for Gnome):
   - If the icon is missing, install AppIndicator from [GNOME Extensions](https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/615/appindicator-support/).

For more detailed instructions, visit the [Infomaniak documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/617/install-kdrive-on-linux).

question: How can I share a file from kDrive?
ground_truth: To share a file/folder in kDrive: 1) Access kDrive web app at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Right-click on the file/folder. 3) Click 'Share...' at the top of the menu. Options: a) Activate a public share link (with options for modification, expiration date, password, download authorization). b) Or enter a kDrive user, contact email, or work team. For each person, define rights: 'viewing', 'modification', or 'management'. Recipients without Infomaniak account can create one free. Warning: deactivating/reactivating public link changes the URL.
key_points: recipients can create free Infomaniak account
answer:
To share a file from kDrive, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your kDrive account.
2. Navigate to the file you want to share.
3. Click on the three dots (⋮) next to the file name.
4. Select "Share" from the dropdown menu.
5. Enter the email addresses of the people you want to share the file with.
6. Set the appropriate permissions (View, Edit, Comment).
7. Click on "Share" to send the invitation.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the official kDrive documentation: [Sharing Files in kDrive](https://www.infomaniak.com/support/faq/2017/how-to-share-files-and-folders-in-kdrive/).

question: What is a Drop Box in kDrive and how do I create one?
ground_truth: A Drop Box in kDrive lets you invite contacts to deposit files/folders directly into your kDrive. To create: 1) Access kDrive at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Navigate to the folder that will host the data (personal or shared). 3) Click the blue 'New' button. 4) Click 'Drop Box'. 5) Enter a name. 6) Choose access settings. 7) Click 'Create'. 8) Share the link with contacts. Advanced options: email notification on deposit, password protection, expiration date, storage limit. To disable: go to Shares > Drop boxes, right-click and select 'Disable' (converts to regular folder).
key_points: can set password, expiration, storage limit
answer:
A Drop Box in kDrive is a shared space that allows others to upload files to your kDrive without requiring them to have a kDrive account. It's a convenient way to collect files from multiple people.

Here's how to create a Drop Box in kDrive:

1. Log in to your kDrive account.
2. Navigate to the folder where you want to create the Drop Box.
3. Click on the "New" button in the top right corner.
4. Select "Drop Box" from the dropdown menu.
5. Give your Drop Box a name and set any additional options as needed.
6. Click "Create" to finalize the Drop Box.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the official Infomaniak documentation on Drop Boxes in kDrive [here](https://infomaniak.com/support/faq/2017/11/14/how-to-create-a-drop-box-in-kdrive).

question: How do I resolve sync conflicts in kDrive?
ground_truth: Sync conflicts occur when: a file is modified locally AND on kDrive Web simultaneously, or during conflicting create/move operations. Resolution: kDrive Web version is kept, local version is saved as '[filename]_conflict'. Options: 1) Keep both (only original syncs). 2) Delete _conflict if it's older. 3) Delete original and rename _conflict to sync it. 4) Manually merge then delete _conflict. To view conflicts: click kDrive icon > info button > view events. From version 3.6.11, locally modified files are moved to 'kDrive Rescue Folder' instead of deleted. Avoid conflicts by not working on the same file with multiple people.
key_points: conflicts when same file modified locally and online
can keep both, delete, or merge
answer:
To resolve sync conflicts in kDrive, follow these steps:

1. **Display Conflicts:**
   - Left-click on the kDrive icon in the notification area.
   - Click on the information button at the top.
   - Click on the listed event to view its details.

2. **Resolve Conflicts:**
   - Choose how to resolve the conflict by deciding to send the local version to the server or to the computer's recycle bin.

3. **Avoid Future Conflicts:**
   - Do not work on the same file with multiple people unless you are working online on a Word, Excel, or PowerPoint document.
   - Synchronize your offline modifications before modifying the same files online.
   - Avoid creating folders that have the same name as folders you do not synchronize on a device.

4. **Manually Resolve Conflicts:**
   - Open both files.
   - Compare the differences.
   - Retrieve the information from the conflict file (the one with the exclamation mark) in the base file.
   - Delete the conflict file that is not synchronized (the one with the exclamation mark and the note `conflicted copy`).

For more detailed instructions, refer to the [Resolve a kDrive synchronization conflict](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2403) guide.

question: How do I manage user rights in kDrive?
ground_truth: kDrive has 2 permission levels: 1) Administrator - same rights as owner (sharing, statistics, restore/delete folders, import data, access all files). 2) User - access folders at root, create/share content, but cannot manage product, view statistics, or create root folders. To modify: 1) Go to ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Click action menu next to the kDrive. 3) Click 'Manage users'. 4) Select user and choose access level. Note: Don't confuse Manager rights (product management) with kDrive rights (data access). A user can have restricted Manager rights but be Administrator in kDrive.
key_points: don't confuse Manager rights with kDrive rights
answer:
To manage user rights in kDrive, follow these steps:

1. **Access User Management**:
   - Click [here](https://manager.infomaniak.com/v3/ng/accounts/rights/users/list) to access user management on the Infomaniak Manager.

2. **Modify User Role**:
   - Click on the action menu **⋮** located to the right of the user concerned.
   - Click on **Modify the role**.
   - Modify the desired role and click on the **Save** button.

3. **Manage Permissions**:
   - To modify the role of a user, you need to be an Administrator or Legal Representative within the Organization.
   - You can assign roles such as Legal Representative, Administrator, or Collaborator.

4. **Add a User**:
   - Click [here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive) to access the Infomaniak kDrive Web app.
   - Check or select the relevant kDrive in the dropdown menu of the left sidebar.
   - Click on the action menu **⋮** located to the right of the relevant item.
   - Click on **Invite a new user**.
   - Add a user to the Drive or add a user to your Organization.
   - Enter the contact details or email address of the user to be invited and specify their rights.
   - Click on **Invite**.

5. **Modify User Permissions**:
   - Click [here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive) to access the Infomaniak kDrive Web app.
   - Check or select the relevant kDrive in the dropdown menu of the left sidebar.
   - Click on the action menu **⋮** located to the right of the relevant item.
   - Click on **Manage users**.
   - Manage the desired user's rights and choose the desired access level.

6. **Delete a User**:
   - Click [here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive) to access the Infomaniak kDrive Web app.
   - Check or select the relevant kDrive in the dropdown menu of the left sidebar.
   - Click on the action menu **⋮** located to the right of the item in question.
   - Click on **Manage users**.
   - Click on the action menu **⋮** to the right of the user in question in the table that appears.
   - Click on **Remove the user**.
   - Choose whether or not to keep the user's data and click on **Delete access rights**.

For more detailed information, refer to the [Infomaniak documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1633/manage-a-users-rights-within-an-organization).

question: How can I access kDrive files locally without downloading them?
ground_truth: To access kDrive files locally: 1) Install the kDrive desktop app. 2) Click on the kDrive icon in notification area (top right macOS, bottom right Windows, double-click on Linux). 3) Click action menu at top right. 4) Choose 'Open kDrive Web' to access server files. 5) Or click the item above to open the local folder. Files can be physically present or virtually present (if Lite Sync is enabled). Lite Sync allows files to appear locally without taking up disk space - they download on demand when opened.
key_points: Open kDrive Web for server files
answer:
To access kDrive files locally without downloading them, you can use the kDrive desktop application. Here's how:

1. **Install the kDrive desktop app** on your device.
2. **Launch the kDrive application** and perform a left-click on the app icon in the notification area of your computer.
3. **Click on the action menu** (⋮) at the top right.
4. **Click on Open kDrive Web** to access the files stored on the kDrive server.
5. **Click on the item above** to open the folder on your computer containing your kDrive files. These files are either physically present or virtually present, depending on whether [Lite Sync](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/lite%20sync) is enabled.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the [Infomaniak documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2456/access-kdrive-files-locally-and-online).

question: How do I sync kDrive with my Synology NAS?
ground_truth: To sync kDrive with Synology NAS via WebDAV: Prerequisites: Synology NAS accessible from Internet, know your kDrive ID. Steps: 1) Log in to Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM). 2) Install Cloud Sync from Package Center if needed. 3) Open Cloud Sync. 4) Click + to add a Cloud. 5) Choose WebDAV. 6) Enter: Server address: https://[kDriveID].connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com, Username: Infomaniak email, Password: create an application password. 7) Select local folder, destination, and sync type: Bidirectional (changes in both directions), Download remote only (backup kDrive to NAS), or Download local only (backup NAS to kDrive).
key_points: Bidirectional, Download remote, or Download local sync
answer:
To sync kDrive with your Synology NAS, follow these steps:

1. **Log in to the Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM).**
2. **Download and install the Cloud Sync app** from the Package Center if necessary.
3. **Open Cloud Sync** and click on the **+** button at the bottom left to add a Cloud.
4. **Choose WebDAV** from the list of available Clouds.
5. **Enter the following account parameters:**
   - **Server address:** `https://IDkDrive.connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com` (replace `IDkDrive` with your kDrive identifier)
   - **Username:** Your email address used to log in to your Infomaniak account
   - **Password:** Create an application password specifically for this use.
6. **Select the local folder, destination, and desired synchronization type:**
   - **Bidirectional:** Changes will be reflected in both directions.
   - **Download only remote changes:** Ideal for saving a kDrive to your NAS.
   - **Download only local changes:** Ideal for saving data from your NAS to a kDrive.

For more detailed instructions, refer to the [Infomaniak documentation on syncing Synology with kDrive](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2404/sync-synology-with-kdrive).

question: How do I create a channel in kChat?
ground_truth: To create a channel in kChat: 1) Click the button in the left sidebar of kChat web app (ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat). 2) Click 'Create a new channel'. 3) Set: A) Name (modifiable later), B) URL (lowercase, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores), C) Private or Public status, D) Description. Every Organization has a default 'General' channel for all users. Public channels are visible to all; Private channels require invitation. To convert public to private: click channel > chevron > Convert (permanent). To leave: chevron > Leave. To archive: chevron > Archive. Can also add to favorites, mute, or organize by categories.
answer:
To create a channel in kChat, follow these steps:

1. Click on the button located in the left sidebar of the kChat web app (online service [ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat)).
2. Click on **Create a new channel**.
3. Choose the name, URL, status (private or public), and description for the channel.
4. Click on **Create Channel** to finalize.

Source: [Manage a kChat channel](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2732/manage-a-kchat-channel)

question: What slash commands are available in kChat?
ground_truth: To use slash commands in kChat: 1) Click in the composition field. 2) Type / followed by the command. 3) Send. Typing just / shows available commands in a modal (like going offline). You can create custom slash commands: 1) Open kChat web or desktop app. 2) Click 'New' icon next to organization name. 3) Click 'Integrations'. 4) Click 'Slash command'. 5) Add a command with name, trigger, content type, and action. Custom commands can call external APIs or run scripts. Note: External users cannot see the Integrations menu.
answer:
The main slash commands available in kChat are:

- `/offline` - Set your status to offline.
- `/online` - Set your status to online.
- `/away` - Set your status to away.
- `/dnd` - Set your status to do not disturb.

These commands allow you to manage your availability and notification preferences within kChat. For more detailed information, you can refer to the [kChat slash commands documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2134/using-kchat-slash-commands).

question: How can I connect external applications to kChat?
ground_truth: To connect external apps to kChat using webhooks: 1) Open kChat web or desktop app. 2) Click 'New' icon next to organization name. 3) Click 'Integrations'. 4) Access webhook categories. For incoming webhooks (receive messages from external apps): 1) Click 'Incoming Webhooks'. 2) Add name and description. 3) Select destination channel. 4) Save to get URL. 5) External app sends POST request with JSON: {"text": "message"}. For outgoing webhooks: kChat sends info when events occur. Parameters include channel override, username, icon_url. Response includes message details. Add ?slack_return_format=true for Slack-style response.
key_points: Incoming webhooks receive from external apps
Outgoing webhooks send to external apps
POST request with JSON text field
answer:
To connect external applications to kChat, you can use webhooks. Here's how you can do it:

1. **Access the kChat webhooks interface**:
   - Click here to access the kChat Web app or open the kChat desktop app.
   - Click on the "New" icon next to your kChat organization's name.
   - Click on "Integrations".
   - Access the categories to find self-hosted or third-party applications and integrations.

2. **Configure a webhook**:
   - For outgoing webhooks, kChat will communicate information to other apps when an event occurs in kChat.
   - For incoming webhooks, kChat will receive information from other apps to trigger actions in kChat.

3. **Integration example**:
   - You can follow a specific guide like "Reminder of Infomaniak calendar event on kChat" to set up a specific integration.

For more detailed instructions and specific integration examples, you can refer to the [Infomaniak documentation on connecting external applications to kChat](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2001/connect-external-applications-to-kchat).

question: How do I translate a message in kChat?
ground_truth: To translate a message in kChat: 1) Access kChat via ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat, or the mobile app (iOS/Android), or desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux). 2) View the message to translate. 3) Click the action menu (three dots) at the top right of the message. 4) Click 'Translate'. 5) The translated message appears below your conversation and is only visible to you. The translation is automatic into your own language.
key_points: click action menu (three dots) on message
answer:
To translate a message in kChat, follow these steps:

1. Open the kChat app (web, mobile, or desktop version).
2. View the message you want to translate.
3. Click on the action menu (•••) located at the top right of the message.
4. Select "Translate" from the menu.
5. The translated message will appear below your conversation and will be visible only to you.

Source: [Translate the content of a message on the kChat Infomaniak app](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1467/translate-the-content-of-a-message-on-the-kchat-infomaniak-app)
sources: [Translate the content of a message on the kChat Infomaniak app](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1467/translate-the-content-of-a-message-on-the-kchat-infomaniak-app)

question: How can I invite external users to kChat?
ground_truth: To invite external users to kChat: Prerequisites: Be Organization administrator with full kChat rights. Steps: 1) Access kChat at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat or desktop app. 2) Click 'Invite members' button. 3) Click link to invite new user. 4) Enter email address(es). 5) Specify channel(s) they'll access. 6) Click send invitation. Invited users receive email with link to the channel. They must create Infomaniak account if needed. External users are not counted as regular users. Guests CAN: pin messages, use slash commands, add favorites, mute, update profile. Guests CANNOT: discover public channels, join open teams, create DMs with non-channel members, invite people.
key_points: external users not counted as users
answer:
To invite external users to kChat, follow these steps:

1. **Access kChat**:
   - [Click here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat) to access the **kChat Web app** (online service [ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat)) or open the **kChat desktop app** (desktop application on macOS / Windows / Linux).

2. **Invite Members**:
   - Click the button to **Invite members**.

3. **Invite New Users**:
   - Click the link to invite a new user.

4. **Specify Email Addresses**:
   - Enter the email address(es) of the person(s) you want to invite.

5. **Select Channels**:
   - Specify the channel(s) to which these people will have access.

6. **Send Invitation**:
   - Click the blue button to send the invitation.

7. **User Registration**:
   - The invited person receives an email with a link leading to the kChat interface and the **channel** shared with them.
   - They need to register if they do not already have an Infomaniak account.

8. **Access kChat**:
   - Once registration is complete, the newly registered user can log in to their [Manager](https://manager.infomaniak.com/) and access kChat to which they have been invited.

For more detailed information, you can refer to the official documentation [here](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2846/invite-an-external-user-to-use-kchat).

question: What is Euria and how do I use it in kChat?
